Initial release: Directly query angi.com public data via the fpx CLI, without the MCP bridge.

- Use fpx (with Transporter extension) to fetch Angi pros, reviews, ratings, and city/trade taxonomy.
- No Angi login required for public data; signed-in account data also supported.
- Trade/city taxonomy is available via plain curl to XML sitemaps; pro/rating/review data via fpx get.
- Provides setup instructions and extraction recipes for Next.js (RSC and __NEXT_DATA__) data formats.
- Highlights limitations (e.g., Twilio messaging unreadable, strict slug/path formats).
- Outlines error codes and troubleshooting guidance.
